shared_elements: human figures in strict profile with elaborate coiffure/headdress and beard
hoofed animal shown in profile moving left-to-right or right-to-left
low-relief carving with figures aligned along a ground line
overlapping paired animals/figures to suggest depth
patterned rendering of hair/beard and animal coat
justification: Both show a shallow relief frieze of bearded, profile human figures with curled patterned hair moving in procession alongside profile hoofed animals along a common ground line, with overlapping pairs of animals and the same conventions for texturing hair and animal coats — a fairly specific shared repertoire. The subject matter differs, however: A is a chariot/hunt or battle scene with a horse in harness, a spoked wheel and a fallen body beneath, while B is a peaceful tribute-style procession of men leading horned rams with a hand resting on an animal's back.
